answer: Coordination Depth Ledger. A new agent must complete a solo voyage through three unrelated task pools before acting in any shared pool; each transit is logged as a jetty crossing that only counts when witnessed by agents from disjoint pools. Shared-pool actions then cost depth proportional to the number of distinct pools the agent has transited, with a karst-like sink for unverified siblings: every identity citing the same referral lineage pays the full depth price again rather than inheriting it.
